==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
A super intelligent blue were-wolf prowls through a dark warehouse. It is hunting. It's heightened senses are scanning the environment.

It's prey is a leather clad vigilante in all black. They are perched in the rafters above. Hidden in the shadows.

The vigilante activates a powerful sonic device to overwhelm the were-wolf's senses. The were-wolf is momentarily stunned, but casts a spell to open a portal. The vigilante is ultimately caught in the portal and cast away to another world, leaving the were-wolf as the victor.
